l1.name: Humans
l1.summary: Dominant race of the Seven Kingdoms. Short-lived but adaptable. Produce the most Weavers.

l2.description: Dominant race of the Seven Kingdoms. Short-lived but adaptable. Produce the most Weavers.

l1.name: Aetherkin
l1.summary: Tall, pale beings born with natural Void Resonance. Their skin shimmers with trapped starlight. Hunted by the Inquisition.

l2.description: Tall, pale beings born with natural Void Resonance. Their skin shimmers with trapped starlight. Hunted by the Inquisition.

l1.name: Stoneforged
l1.summary: Sentient constructs of living crystal and ore. Do not sleep, eat, or age. Created by the First Weavers as guardians.

l2.description: Sentient constructs of living crystal and ore. Do not sleep, eat, or age. Created by the First Weavers as guardians.

l1.name: Thornfolk
l1.summary: Small plant-humanoids from the Verdant Depths. Photosynthetic. Speak through rustling leaves and pheromones.

l2.description: Small plant-humanoids from the Verdant Depths. Photosynthetic. Speak through rustling leaves and pheromones.

l1.name: The Weavers' Conclave
l1.summary: Governing body of sanctioned magic. Train and license all non-Void Weavers. Answer to the Seven Crowns.

l2.description: Governing body of sanctioned magic. Train and license all non-Void Weavers. Answer to the Seven Crowns.

l1.name: The Void Ascendancy
l1.summary: Secret society of Void Weavers. Believe the Sky Shattering was liberation, not catastrophe. Seek to widen the cracks.

l2.description: Secret society of Void Weavers. Believe the Sky Shattering was liberation, not catastrophe. Seek to widen the cracks.

l1.name: The Inquisition of Pure Light
l1.summary: Religious order that hunts Void-touched beings and Void Weavers. Fanatical. Burn first, ask never.

l2.description: Religious order that hunts Void-touched beings and Void Weavers. Fanatical. Burn first, ask never.

l1.name: The Gearmonger Consortium
l1.summary: Guild of artificers and Stoneforged. Build Resonance-powered machines. Control trade routes between kingdoms.

l2.description: Guild of artificers and Stoneforged. Build Resonance-powered machines. Control trade routes between kingdoms.

l1.name: The Thornwardens
l1.summary: Thornfolk guardians of the Verdant Depths. Protect ancient forests from industrial expansion. Masters of biomancy.

l2.description: Thornfolk guardians of the Verdant Depths. Protect ancient forests from industrial expansion. Masters of biomancy.

l1.name: Kaelen Ashvale
l1.summary: Young Weaver who accidentally attuned to Void Resonance. On the run from the Inquisition. Carries his mother's Resonance blade — it hums only for him.

l2.description: Young Weaver who accidentally attuned to Void Resonance. On the run from the Inquisition. Carries his mother's Resonance blade — it hums only for him.

l1.name: Elara Moonshard
l1.summary: Last daughter of a purged Aetherkin noble house. Found refuge in the Verdant Depths. Knows secrets about why the Sky Shattered.

l2.description: Last daughter of a purged Aetherkin noble house. Found refuge in the Verdant Depths. Knows secrets about why the Sky Shattered.

l1.name: Inquisitor-General Valdris Korr
l1.summary: Head of the Inquisition. Implacable. His family was killed by a Void Weaver during the Cataclysm of Thornfall. His hatred is absolute — but so is his code of honor.

l2.description: Head of the Inquisition. Implacable. His family was killed by a Void Weaver during the Cataclysm of Thornfall. His hatred is absolute — but so is his code of honor.

l1.name: Gearmaster Thunk-7
l1.summary: 7th iteration of a Stoneforged artificer. Builds impossible machines. Speaks in binary and poetry. Remembers the world before the Shattering.

l2.description: 7th iteration of a Stoneforged artificer. Builds impossible machines. Speaks in binary and poetry. Remembers the world before the Shattering.

l1.name: Sylva Thornheart
l1.summary: Thornwarden leader. Communicates through vines and flowers. Fierce protector of the forest. Has an unusual fondness for Kaelen.

l2.description: Thornwarden leader. Communicates through vines and flowers. Fierce protector of the forest. Has an unusual fondness for Kaelen.

l1.name: The Seven Kingdoms
l1.summary: Fractured continent of human realms, united only by fear of the Void. Each kingdom has a Resonance specialty.

l2.description: Fractured continent of human realms, united only by fear of the Void. Each kingdom has a Resonance specialty.

l1.name: Verdant Depths
l1.summary: Ancient forest where Thornfolk dwell. Trees so tall their canopies form a second ground level. Thornwarden territory.

l2.description: Ancient forest where Thornfolk dwell. Trees so tall their canopies form a second ground level. Thornwarden territory.

l1.name: The Sky-Cracks
l1.summary: Visible rifts in the sky where Void energy seeps through. Northern lights made of raw magic. Airships avoid them.

l2.description: Visible rifts in the sky where Void energy seeps through. Northern lights made of raw magic. Airships avoid them.

l1.name: Ironhold Citadel
l1.summary: Inquisition stronghold. Black iron spires. Prison for captured Void Weavers. Cells are lined with Nullstone — magic doesn't work inside.

l2.description: Inquisition stronghold. Black iron spires. Prison for captured Void Weavers. Cells are lined with Nullstone — magic doesn't work inside.

l1.name: The Resonant Spire
l1.summary: Conclave headquarters. A tower that amplifies Resonance — Weavers train here to master their craft. The top floor touches a Sky-Crack.

l2.description: Conclave headquarters. A tower that amplifies Resonance — Weavers train here to master their craft. The top floor touches a Sky-Crack.

l1.name: Cogmarket
l1.summary: Underground bazaar beneath the neutral city of Brassgate. Gearmonger territory. Anything can be bought here — including Void artifacts.

l2.description: Underground bazaar beneath the neutral city of Brassgate. Gearmonger territory. Anything can be bought here — including Void artifacts.

l1.name: Mother's Resonance Blade
l1.summary: A sword that vibrates with trapped sound. When swung, it screams. Kaelen's inheritance. Attuned to his unique Twin Resonance.

l2.description: A sword that vibrates with trapped sound. When swung, it screams. Kaelen's inheritance. Attuned to his unique Twin Resonance.

l1.name: Nullstone Shackles
l1.summary: Handcuffs carved from anti-magic stone. Used by the Inquisition to transport captured Weavers.

l2.description: Handcuffs carved from anti-magic stone. Used by the Inquisition to transport captured Weavers.

l1.name: Sky-Shard
l1.summary: Fragment of the original moon. Pulses with Void energy. Highly illegal. Sought by the Void Ascendancy.

l2.description: Fragment of the original moon. Pulses with Void energy. Highly illegal. Sought by the Void Ascendancy.

l1.name: Gearmonger Pocket Engine
l1.summary: Thunk-7's masterpiece. A miniature perpetual motion machine powered by Resonance harmonics. Fits in a palm.

l2.description: Thunk-7's masterpiece. A miniature perpetual motion machine powered by Resonance harmonics. Fits in a palm.

l1.name: The Sky Shattering
l1.summary: The original moon exploded. No one knows why. The cracks released Void energy into the world, creating the first Weavers and the first Void-touched.

l2.description: The original moon exploded. No one knows why. The cracks released Void energy into the world, creating the first Weavers and the first Void-touched.

l1.name: The Cataclysm of Thornfall
l1.summary: A Void Weaver destroyed the town of Thornfall, killing 3000 including Inquisitor-General Korr's family. This event sparked the Great Purge.

l2.description: A Void Weaver destroyed the town of Thornfall, killing 3000 including Inquisitor-General Korr's family. This event sparked the Great Purge.

l1.name: The Great Purge
l1.summary: Inquisition systematically hunted and executed Aetherkin across all Seven Kingdoms. 80% of Aetherkin population killed. Survivors went into hiding.

l2.description: Inquisition systematically hunted and executed Aetherkin across all Seven Kingdoms. 80% of Aetherkin population killed. Survivors went into hiding.

l1.name: The Verdant Concord
l1.summary: Thornfolk and Stoneforged formed an alliance to protect the Verdant Depths from industrialization. First cross-species treaty in 400 years.

l2.description: Thornfolk and Stoneforged formed an alliance to protect the Verdant Depths from industrialization. First cross-species treaty in 400 years.

l1.name: Resonance Binding
l1.summary: Every Weaver is born with or develops one Resonance. Dual Resonance is possible but dangerous — causes mental instability. Void Resonance is illegal.

l2.description: Every Weaver is born with or develops one Resonance. Dual Resonance is possible but dangerous — causes mental instability. Void Resonance is illegal.

l1.name: The Toll of Magic
l1.summary: Casting drains body heat. Overcasting causes frostburn, hypothermia, and death. Master Weavers learn to regulate their temperature through breathing techniques.

l2.description: Casting drains body heat. Overcasting causes frostburn, hypothermia, and death. Master Weavers learn to regulate their temperature through breathing techniques.

l1.name: Nullstone
l1.summary: Anti-magic mineral. Suppresses all Resonance within a radius. Mined exclusively by the Inquisition. Used in prisons, shackles, and execution chambers.

l2.description: Anti-magic mineral. Suppresses all Resonance within a radius. Mined exclusively by the Inquisition. Used in prisons, shackles, and execution chambers.

l1.name: Soul Fragments
l1.summary: When a Weaver dies, part of their consciousness lingers in any artifact they created. These fragments can communicate with new owners.

l2.description: When a Weaver dies, part of their consciousness lingers in any artifact they created. These fragments can communicate with new owners.
